scene.introEn: The power went out and every door locked. Open three locks before the guard comes back.
scene.introJa: 停電で扉がすべて閉まった。警備員が戻る前に3つの錠を開けよう。

keyExpressions.en: What number is the red star?
Let me check. Is it four, seven, one, two?

skip_color.standard: Ignore every {color} symbol when you read the row.

skip_shape.standard: Leave out every {shape} when you read the row.

reverse.easy: Read it from right to left.
reverse.standard: Read the row backwards, starting from the right end.

swap_ends.easy: Swap the first and last numbers.
swap_ends.standard: Switch the first number with the last one.
swap_ends.ja: 最初と最後の数字を入れ替える

add_one.easy: Add one to each number. Nine becomes zero.
add_one.standard: Make every number one bigger, and turn nine into zero.
add_one.ja: すべての数字に1を足す（9は0にする）
